snippet.title: Paper Beast Enhanced Edition - Launch Trailer | PS5 & PS VR2 Games
snippet.description:
Paper Beast Enhanced Edition is NOW AVAILABLE on PlayStation®VR2 and PS5. Embark on an extraordinary adventure and help a living world. The original game was praised for its innovative gameplay, unique aesthetics, and surreal universe. This out-of-this-world adventure fully leverages the capabilities of the PS VR2 and PS5, offering enhanced features and improved immersion.

Paper Beast © 2016-2023 Pixel Reef
